在一堆了无生机的构造体之间，我们探测到了一个雕刻之物，它的意志正在将高浓度能量塑造成新的奇特形态。

如果我们拿了会发生什么？
texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a Sculpting Presence, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haze. It offers something.

What will happen if we grasp it?

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为雕刻之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sculpting Presence.

texts.zh:
随着我们将自己的心灵浸泡入虚境翻腾的能量中，[GetSpeciesBodyPlural]奇怪地震颤起来。我们感受到雕刻之物短暂地抓住了我们。祂呼唤我们仔细看。

顺着指示的方向看去，意味深长的微暗渐渐退去，一个剪影显露出来。它的四肢被一股又一股虚无的绳索猛烈地拉扯，随后绳索突然消失，那个人形塌了下去。

它抽动着活了过来，一肢跟着一肢慢慢地站起，摆脱了束缚后，又开始了催眠般的舞蹈。
texts.en:
As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the Sculpting Presence momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.

The pregnant dimness ebbed away to reveal a gesturing silhouette. Its limbs were pulled sharply, one way then another, by vapory cords until, suddenly, its tethers dissipated. The figure collapsed.

Slowly it twitched back to life. Limb by limb it rose, without its former ties, and resumed its hypnotic dance.

texts.zh: 我们意识到这个实体并不陌生。抟土之塑师玩得很开心。凡是无生命之物被唤醒，或是沉闷之物充盈起了灵魂的地方，都能找到祂。
texts.en: We realized then that we have encountered this entity before. The Animator of Clay was entertained. Wherever the inanimate is awakened, and where dull matter is imbued with soul, it too can be found.

label.zh: 人偶摆脱丝线自由舞蹈。
label.en: The puppet dances free of its strings.

# 抟土之塑师 / Animator of Clay

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/minor_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“抟土之塑师”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4050），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1344），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4050) of the minor patron "Animator of Clay", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1344) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4050：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8638，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4050: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8638, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4055。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4055 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4055仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed，并获得每月佐罗(Zro)产出。  
  shroud.4055 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed and grants monthly Zro output.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
